submitted.rationale: EQE rose steadily as Fe increased: -0.006% at Fe0.52, 0.029% at Fe0.75 and 0.16% at Fe0.87. At 2.1 eV illumination, Fe-rich films should absorb more. XRD shows the rutile-type phase across the whole line. Index 0 also has a weak extra low-Q peak (Q=0.80), which suggests an Fe-rich secondary phase. Index 0 was the most Fe-rich candidate and had the highest measured EQE.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE about 0 (-0.006%) at the near-1:1 FeSbO4 composition
Merit trend points to Fe-rich; XRD shows extra Sb-oxide-like peaks, and Sb-rich films should absorb less at 2.1 eV; not measured because the budget ran out
